meta.name: The Good Bad Mother
meta.description:
A tragic accident leaves an ambitious prosecutor with the mind of a child – forcing him and his mother to embark on a journey to heal their relationship.

Complete series. On your server: S1 14/14

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: After a tragedy turns her world upside down, Jin Young-soon raises her son with the aim of steering him away from a life of hardship like hers.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Filled with childhood resentment, Choi Kang-ho navigates his career with ruthless ambition — later approaching Young-soon with a cruel motive.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A shocking accident leaves Kang-ho's outlook uncertain. Young-soon takes him home and seizes an opportunity for redemption.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: As Kang-ho recovers, he and Young-soon get closer. However, Young-soon later visits Seoul and witnesses unfavorable traces of Kang-ho's life.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: After retuning home, Lee Mi-joo encounters Kang-ho in his new condition. Young-soon faces aggression from an unrelenting neighbor.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kang-ho experiences a mysterious attack. Mi-joo finds an fortuitous business opportunity. The town convenes to rally against Young-soon.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Young-soon panics about the future after she receives scary news. Another sudden blow forces her to make hard decisions about herself and Kang-ho.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Young-soon pushes Kang-ho to the limits. She later finds a perplexing item from her son's old life. Mi-joo navigates her complex feelings around Kang-ho.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Young-soon and Kang-ho go through recollections of Kang-ho's past — discovering another side to his story.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Young-soon prepares Kang-ho for a safer future. After a startling incident, Mi-joo and Kang-ho share a tender moment — further complicating their lives.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: With Mi-joo by his side, Kang-ho finds out the truth after an alarming moment. Bang Sam-sik gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: After a frightening incident at the farm, Young-soon discovers more information. As Kang-ho proceeds with his plan, Mi-joo and Sam-sik follow suit.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Mi-joo and Sam-sik risk their safety to track down a key witness. Young-soon finds support from her friends.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Kang-ho enacts his final plan to take down Oh Tae-soo. Young-soon gives Kang-ho and Mi-joo her blessings.

meta.slogan: All mothers in the world are bad.
